scope: Fictional fixtures; no originals, clinical outputs, expert returns, downloads or model calls

cases.given: All 178 schema-1 products and 83 providers
cases.when: Migrate with an exact source hash
cases.expect: Stable IDs and all collection/parse/science fields preserved; no implicit promotions

cases.given: Wrong or missing source catalog SHA-256
cases.expect: Reject before publication; no partial policy

cases.given: Duplicate IDs, unknown dependencies, input dependency cycle, duplicate JSON keys or unsupported fields
cases.expect: Reject each independently

cases.given: Existing frozen schema-1 fixture and exact archived catalog
cases.expect: Same prior guarantees; schema 2 passed directly to legacy reader is rejected

cases.given: genetics_results and genetics_qc_cases
cases.expect: QC only in validation_dependencies; retained legacy edge and explicit rationale; no predicted values or acquired status fabricated

cases.given: A predictor's actual source DAG includes QC answer bytes
cases.when: Use agent role despite a separate validation attestation
cases.expect: Reject evaluator ancestry; attestations cannot authorize consumed answers

cases.given: Method-specific ABF, SuSiE and Wald fixtures
cases.expect: No unconditional dense LD requirement for ABF or single-instrument Wald; LD required for declared LD-dependent method; no scientific qualification inferred

cases.given: program_linkage optional vbt_linkage with evaluation_only plus reference roles
cases.expect: Deny; optional/reference labeling does not erase evaluator restriction

cases.given: Optional genetics group not selected for an arm
cases.expect: Do not retrieve/add genetics; unavailable feature stays absent, not zero

cases.given: scorer_artifacts genuinely trained using dated_outcomes and split_definitions
cases.when: Migrate or request general evidence admission
cases.expect: Preserve training ancestry; do not move labels to validation_dependencies; block unsupported inference admission

cases.given: An evaluator artifact depending on evaluator inputs
cases.expect: Description allowed, but no agent-visible use is authorized

cases.given: Virtual Biotech requirement with an absent historical component
cases.expect: Mark missing; no modern substitution or unconditional download

cases.given: Correct dataset/release with unknown path or source hash
cases.expect: Reject; product eligibility is not an artifact grant

cases.given: AACT origin and endpoint artifacts of the same product
cases.when: Request origin use for endpoint artifact
cases.expect: Reject unless a distinct qualified protocol/use exists; no role inferred from date

cases.given: January 2023 AACT identity with null exact first-public availability
cases.expect: Blocked temporal qualification; technical restoration is not historical admission

cases.given: July 2023 requested July 1 but actual dump July 2
cases.expect: Retain July 2 release identity and discrepancy; never silently relabel

cases.given: AACT January/April 2026 evaluator records
cases.expect: Endpoint/ascertainment use only; no agent-visible grant or clinical-success qualification

cases.given: One artifact has two uses with different origin/protocol hashes
cases.when: Select a use without an exact unique match
cases.expect: Reject ambiguity; cannot pick the most permissive match

cases.given: Same URL/path/hash/size but wrong receipt_id, dataset_id or release_id
cases.expect: Reject each; include case-only identity changes

cases.given: Same receipt identity and payload but a changed URL path case or relative path case
cases.expect: Reject contract identity mismatch on Windows as well as Linux

cases.given: Legacy transport receipt omits receipt_id or source URL
cases.expect: Unresolved/denied, not a permissive fallback; manually supplied archives use a different explicit evidence kind

cases.given: Original exists but receipt/hash evidence is missing
cases.expect: No collection promotion; existence observation only

cases.given: Neutral retained report proves a past technical check
cases.when: Import without hashing original bytes now
cases.expect: Retained-check date/scope preserved; no fresh verification, parse or science claim

cases.given: Transport receipt changes after a prior immutable archive copy
cases.expect: Use exact archived receipt; do not rewrite it or silently follow mutable transport metadata

cases.given: An existing content-addressed receipt path contains conflicting bytes
cases.expect: Reject; no clobber

cases.given: Manifest has an extra unused evaluator source node
cases.expect: Reject before dispatch; inspect all supplied nodes, not only selected IDs

cases.given: Generated packet uses undeclared mapping or evaluator parent
cases.expect: Reject complete-parent mismatch even if output product itself is allowed

cases.given: Case/snapshot/manifest or receipt file changes between check and execution
cases.expect: Use sealed verified copies or fail; never load unchecked changed originals; zero backend calls for preflight rejection

cases.given: Traversal, alias collision, duplicate artifact key or path outside approved root
cases.expect: Reject before biological-value read

cases.given: Valid selected artifact/use and fully eligible actual parent graph
cases.expect: Deterministic projection; unselected products denied; selected identities and profile/cutoff bound; required legacy fields intact

cases.given: Internally valid inner run with missing or substituted schema-2 policy
cases.expect: Reject stronger policy claim independently of legacy byte/semantic success

cases.given: Valid projection from another run with changed case/use/cutoff/snapshot
cases.expect: Reject cross-run transplant; reconstruct exact bound projection

cases.given: Future publication or annotation in an otherwise allowed artifact
cases.expect: Existing temporal/publication gate still rejects; policy does not override it

cases.given: Empty/partial/failed run after successful policy preflight
cases.expect: Policy disposition and inner execution failure remain separate and readable; no repeat dispatch

cases.given: Concurrent preparation or write failure in the same destination
cases.expect: Single owner/no overwrite; partial attempt readable; no weaker projection reused

cases.given: 178 indexed products but only one declared frame
cases.expect: Default deny; catalog coverage is not data readiness

cases.given: Frozen P05 plan references pre-TETHER catalog SHA
cases.expect: Old plan/code/pins unchanged; no silent rerun or substitution of the live catalog

cases.given: New canonical module with legacy aliases installed
cases.expect: Finite alias inventory resolves the new module; old direct APIs remain documented as weaker, not silently upgraded
